cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Reopen the First Reason
cards.instruction: Keep them present by returning to the first reason for staying and revealing that it now means something different.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm blowing on mine like you. Stay until the tea's cool, at least.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was blowing a tea leaf off the rim. Yours has been cold for ten minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, clearing the rim. Then stay until we've finished drinking it properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can sit for five minutes, but I don't want any more tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll take the five minutes without tea. It's the two of us sitting together I don't want to finish.

reason: Replace an unexplained cooling-things-down metaphor with the exact companionship revealed by B's time-without-tea offer.
